name: SettingsSection
title: Templates/Platform/Page/SettingsSection
summary: A settings band: an h2 with a `Hint` glyph that carries the one-sentence guidance, over a flush card of settings rows, each a title and description with its control on the right. Every settings page stacks it (`stacked`, no rule between bands), from a resource’s Settings tabs to Account Settings and every create page and drawer. An anchored band carries a copy-link button that appears in the gutter when the heading is hovered or focused; a collapsible band turns the heading into a disclosure that unfolds the card along the grid track. Built from `Hint`, `CardBox` and `Item` rows holding `InputText`, `Switch` and `Select`; the split aside layout is still in the markup for a non-stacked band, but no page renders one.

variants.name: Stacked
variants.summary: A resource’s Settings tab: the General and Features bands stacked one under the other at the section gap, with no rule between them.

variants.name: Collapsible
variants.summary: The collapsible Advanced band of Create Team, closed: the cog glyph and the title are the disclosure trigger, and the card unfolds along the grid track when it opens.
